pending_diagnosis: DIAGNOSIS: Ciguatera Fish Poisoning THE SMOKING GUN: Cold allodynia (temperature reversal dysesthesia where cold stimuli feel scalding hot) after consuming a reef predator fish (barracuda). PATHOPHYSIOLOGY: Ciguatoxin is synthesized by marine microalgae (Gambierdiscus toxicus) and bioaccumulates up the food chain into large apex reef fish. The toxin binds directly to site 5 of voltage-gated sodium channels, preventing their inactivation. This results in persistent sodium influx, continuous neuronal depolarization, repetitive nerve firing, and eventual conduction block. The hyper-excitability of A-delta and C nociceptive fibers causes pathognomonic cold allodynia, while cardiac sodium channel activation leads to severe bradycardia and refractory hypotension.
